description: This file contains Go test code for snapshot management in the Android Cuttlefish project, including test functions for creating, restoring, and verifying device snapshots, as well as helper functions for device creation and snapshot handling.

methods.name: TestSnapshot
methods.description: Main test function that creates a device, takes a snapshot, powerwashes, stops, and restores from snapshot, verifying the device state throughout.

methods.name: uploadArtifacts
methods.description: Uploads necessary artifacts to the host orchestrator service and returns the upload directory.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a CVD device with specified group and artifacts, returning the device object.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the specified device via the host orchestrator service.

methods.name: getCVD
methods.description: Retrieves the first available CVD device from the service.
